tc_name: Search mobile and add single product quantity to 3 then verify cart
description: Validates searching for a mobile, selecting the product, increasing quantity to 3, adding to cart and verifying cart shows quantity 3
precondition: Amazon app installed on Samsung SM-A226B, user on home screen, network available

steps.step_desc: Tap the Search icon on the Amazon home screen
steps.expected: Search input opens and keyboard visible

steps.step_desc: Enter search term 'OnePlus 15' in search input and submit
steps.expected: Search results for 'OnePlus 15' are displayed

steps.step_desc: Select the desired mobile product from results (tap product item)
steps.expected: Product detail page opens for the selected mobile

steps.step_desc: If required, select mandatory variant options (color, storage)
steps.expected: Variant options selected and enabled for purchase

steps.step_desc: Increase the quantity selector to 3
steps.expected: Quantity shows 3 and UI reflects selection

steps.step_desc: Tap 'Add to Cart' button
steps.expected: Item with quantity 3 is added to cart and confirmation/toast appears

steps.step_desc: Open Cart from action bar
steps.expected: Cart screen displays the product with quantity 3 and correct subtotal

tc_name: Add two different mobiles, then remove one to leave only the first with quantity 3
description: Validates adding multiple products, updating quantities and removing a product from cart
precondition: Amazon app installed, user on home, stable network, guest or logged-in user

steps.step_desc: Search and add Mobile A (OnePlus 15) with quantity set to 3 (use steps from TC_001)
steps.expected: Mobile A added to cart with quantity 3

steps.step_desc: Tap Search, search for Mobile B (e.g., Samsung model), select and add to cart with quantity 1
steps.expected: Mobile B added to cart with quantity 1

steps.step_desc: Open Cart
steps.expected: Cart page shows Mobile A (qty 3) and Mobile B (qty 1)

steps.step_desc: Remove Mobile B from cart using 'Remove' or trash action
steps.expected: Mobile B removed and cart updates to show only Mobile A (qty 3)

steps.step_desc: Verify subtotal and item count reflect only Mobile A with quantity 3
steps.expected: Cart total and item count match expected values for 3 units of Mobile A

tc_name: Attempt to increase quantity beyond available stock
description: Validates system prevents increasing quantity beyond stock and shows appropriate error/limit
precondition: Product available with limited stock (e.g., stock = 2), user on product page

steps.step_desc: Open product detail page for item with limited stock
steps.expected: Product page displays available stock information

steps.step_desc: Attempt to set quantity to a value greater than available stock (e.g., 5)
steps.expected: App prevents quantity selection beyond stock OR prompts 'Only X available' message

steps.step_desc: Try to add the excessive quantity to cart
steps.expected: Add to cart is blocked or adjusted to max available; user sees clear error or suggestion

tc_name: Network interruption while adding to cart
description: Validates app behavior when network disconnects during add-to-cart operation and ensures data integrity
precondition: Amazon app installed, network available then will be toggled off (simulate flaky network)

steps.step_desc: Start adding a product to cart (tap Add to Cart) while network is active
steps.expected: Add to Cart request is initiated

steps.step_desc: During the add operation, disable network (turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data) to simulate interruption
steps.expected: Add operation fails or times out gracefully

steps.step_desc: Observe app notification/error and try retrying when network is restored
steps.expected: App shows retry option or queued action; upon restoring network, add completes without duplicate items

tc_name: Use 'See more like this' comparison view and ensure add to cart is handled correctly
description: Validates behavior when user navigates to comparison (See more like this) and attempts to add from compare view
precondition: Search results include 'See more like this' button for a product

steps.step_desc: From product listing, tap 'See more like this' for a product
steps.expected: Comparison lite view opens listing similar products

steps.step_desc: Attempt to add a product directly from the comparison view to cart
steps.expected: Either add to cart is available and functions, or user is navigated to product page to select options before adding

steps.step_desc: Verify cart reflects correct product(s) and quantities
steps.expected: Cart updated correctly without missing variant selections or incorrect quantities

tc_name: Back navigation from search and product page behavior
description: Checks that tapping Back from search/product returns to expected previous screens and preserves state
precondition: Open app, perform a search to reach search results, open a product detail

steps.step_desc: Tap the Search icon and perform a search (e.g., 'OnePlus')
steps.expected: Search results display

steps.step_desc: Open a product from results, then tap the Back icon on the action bar
steps.expected: Navigates back to the search results and preserves scroll position

steps.step_desc: From search results, tap Back again to return to home screen
steps.expected: Navigates back to the home screen or previous app state

tc_name: Orientation change while selecting quantity and adding to cart (compatibility)
description: Validates app maintains selected product, variant and quantity when device orientation changes
precondition: Device Samsung SM-A226B, product page open with variant and quantity selected

steps.step_desc: On product page select variant and set quantity to 3
steps.expected: Variant and quantity set correctly

steps.step_desc: Rotate device from portrait to landscape and back
steps.expected: Product page state (selected variant and quantity) is preserved and UI adjusts to orientation

steps.step_desc: Tap Add to Cart after orientation changes
steps.expected: Add to Cart succeeds and cart reflects selected quantity and variant

tc_name: Attempt to add to cart without selecting mandatory variant options
description: Ensures app forces selection of mandatory options (like color or storage) before allowing add to cart
precondition: Product with mandatory options (color, storage) is opened

steps.step_desc: Open product page that requires selecting variant options
steps.expected: Product page shows variant selection UI

steps.step_desc: Without selecting mandatory options, tap 'Add to Cart'
steps.expected: App prevents add and displays validation message prompting user to select required options

steps.step_desc: Select required options and tap 'Add to Cart' again
steps.expected: Product is added to cart successfully

tc_name: Rapid repeated add-to-cart actions to reach quantity 3 (concurrency/race)
description: Tests rapid user taps on 'Add to Cart' or quantity increment to ensure final cart quantity is correct and no duplicates are created
precondition: Product page open, stable or simulated delayed network

steps.step_desc: Rapidly tap the quantity increment button or 'Add to Cart' three times quickly
steps.expected: UI should debounce clicks and resulting quantity in cart should be exactly 3 (no duplicates beyond 3)

steps.step_desc: Open Cart and verify the quantity for the product
steps.expected: Cart shows quantity 3; no duplicate line items

tc_name: Apply 'All Filters' to narrow search to specific storage option then add product
description: Validates using All Filters to find a 16GB+512GB variant and add it to cart with quantity 3
precondition: Amazon app open on home screen

steps.step_desc: Tap Search and enter broad term like 'OnePlus' then submit
steps.expected: Search results populate

steps.step_desc: Tap 'All Filters' icon and select storage filter '16GB+512GB', apply filters
steps.expected: Results updated to show devices matching 16GB+512GB

steps.step_desc: Select the filtered product, set quantity to 3 and tap 'Add to Cart'
steps.expected: Correct variant added with quantity 3 and confirmation shown

steps.step_desc: Open Cart and verify only the selected filtered product is present with qty 3
steps.expected: Cart shows the product with qty 3 and correct pricing

tc_name: Guest cart persistence and merge after login
description: Validates items added to cart as a guest persist locally and merge with account cart after login
precondition: User not logged in (guest), Amazon app installed

steps.step_desc: As guest, search and add a mobile to cart with quantity 3
steps.expected: Item added to local guest cart with qty 3

steps.step_desc: Tap Sign-in and log in with valid credentials
steps.expected: Login successful and app navigates back to previous screen

steps.step_desc: Open Cart after login
steps.expected: Guest cart items are merged into the user's account cart and quantity remains 3

tc_name: Remove items until cart is empty and verify empty cart UI
description: Ensures removing last item updates the cart to an empty state with appropriate messaging and actions
precondition: Cart contains at least one product (could be qty 3 of one product)

steps.step_desc: Open Cart and remove the product(s) using 'Remove' action until no items remain
steps.expected: Each remove updates the cart; after last removal the cart becomes empty

steps.step_desc: Verify empty cart screen content (message, recommended products, navigation options)
steps.expected: Empty cart UI appears with 'Your Cart is empty' message and CTAs like 'Continue shopping'

steps.step_desc: Attempt to remove an item when cart is already empty
steps.expected: Remove action is disabled or not visible; app does not crash and shows empty cart state
